name: Dunali
description: Troubled by an atypical medical condition that has a direct bearing on a young boy's sexual life, the world around him goes upside down wherein everyone tries to take advantage of his abilities. Some remain smitten while some are shocked when they find the double-trouble that he is blessed with. Watch the laugh-riot doubling its fun in Dunali.
